mapper.sql: id, regulation_id, work_id, single_or_full_type, single_validate_status, create_time, update_time, operator, full_validate_status, content_type, channel
mapper.select: select ivr.id, ivr.regulation_id, ivr.work_id, ivr.single_or_full_type from ins_validate_rule ivr right join ( select max(update_time) as maxUpTime, max(create_time) as maxCreateTime, regulation_id, single_or_full_type, count(regulation_id) from ins_validate_rule where 1=1 group by regulation_id, single_or_full_type ) as ir on ir.regulation_id = ivr.regulation_id and ir.single_or_full_type = ivr.single_or_full_type where if(ir.maxUpTime is not null , ir.maxUpTime = ivr.update_time, ir.maxCreateTime = ivr.create_time)

select id, regulation_id, work_id, single_or_full_type, if(single_validate_status is null,'-1',single_validate_status) as single_validate_status, create_time, update_time, operator, if(full_validate_status is null ,'-1',full_validate_status) as full_validate_status from ins_validate_rule where regulation_id = #{regulationId} order by create_time desc,update_time desc
select single_or_full_type from ins_validate_rule where work_id = #{workId}
